reason: Eight audit findings in the AI scope importer and the legacy 2.x importer. Scope import: a single extracted section longer than the 40,000-character AI chunk raised DocumentTooLargeError for any TXT/MD/HTML/JSON/CSV document over ~40 KB although the advertised limit is 400,000 characters; _document_chunks now splits oversized sections on paragraph/line/word boundaries into labelled parts that fit the chunk. That error, and every KnowledgeIngestionError raised during generation, was rewrapped as ScopeImportError('provider_failed') (422) so the route's 413 handler never ran; create() now re-raises document errors unchanged. A CIDR with host bits set (10.0.0.5/24) was silently widened to 10.0.0.0/24 and stayed ALLOWED; it is now AMBIGUOUS with a 'host bits masked' warning on the candidate and the receipt. An ALLOWED CIDR or wildcard domain that covers an EXCLUDED candidate now carries a 'covers excluded target' warning on the candidate and in the import warnings, since ScopePolicy has no exclusion list. A ScopeImport left at GENERATING by an interrupted Core was stuck forever (apply and discard both 409); the service gains startup() which fails stranded GENERATING rows with a clear error_detail, it is wired into the API lifespan, and discard() accepts FAILED imports. Legacy importer: ip_addresses values that ip_network rejected became allowed_domains entries (10.0.0.1-10.0.0.50 passes the domain regex) or aborted the whole import with a raw pydantic error (10.0.0.5:8080, '10.0.0.0/24 (DMZ)'); ranges are now summarized to CIDRs, hostnames must pass the ScopePolicy domain validator, and everything else is skipped with a receipt warning. Asset typing used a '/32' substring test so 2001:db8::/32 became a host; it now compares prefixlen to max_prefixlen. The receipt never counted Chroma-derived observations, reported a 'tool_selections' count with no entity behind it, and after refusing an external Chroma directory warned again about a sentinel path that was never configured; observations are counted where they are appended, tool_selections is dropped, and the refusal skips the Chroma block. tests/v3/test_scope_import.py (five new tests: oversized-section splitting with every chunk within MAX_CHUNK_CHARACTERS, 413 document error through the API, masked host bits, covered exclusions, stranded GENERATING import failed on lifespan startup and then discardable) and tests/v3/test_importer.py (four new tests: range expansion plus skipped targets with warnings, IPv6 prefix typing, observation count without tool_selections, external-Chroma refusal warning once) all fail on origin/main and pass with the change.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through src/nebula/v3/api.py) does not exercise scope-import chunking, error mapping, startup reconciliation or the legacy 2.x importer; the Python tests drive them directly through the service, the FastAPI TestClient and the importer. No full suites.
